parts.note_add: Housing, rotor and shaft dimensions from the 1982 Technical Data are on the housing and shaft parts.
The linked RockAuto filter is FRAM PH3593A.
Single-wire resistive sender feeding the dash oil pressure gauge on BrY; Atkins sells N201-14-820 new for 1981-91 RX-7.
The 1982 Technical Data gives the same deflection, 15 +/- 2 mm (T:1).
Atkins sells the 81-85 12A engine gasket kit as N201-89-100B; check it against the catalogue number N201-99-100.
Atkins ARE115 is sold against Mazda 1757-23-040.
Very likely the front-cover oil pressure control valve (it follows the front cover rows in the catalogue figure, and its spring changed for 1983 as the manuals show); check.
Mazdatrix sells it new (3743-10-500), main bearing not included.
Atkins lists front main seal N3R1-10-507 for all 1969-2011 rotaries; check it replaces 0820-10-605.
The leading (yellow) and trailing (red) marks on the eccentric shaft pulley are read against this pin.

specs.item: Gauge check: resistance put in place of the sender for each reading
specs.value: 0 psi: open circuit; first mark: 196.7; 60 psi: 141.2; 110 psi: 102.6
specs.note: 1985 combination meter (scale to 110 psi) checked with checker 49 0839 285 on the BrY lead; indication error allowed is twice the needle width; if the gauge reads right the sender is at fault. The 1982 gauge scale is not recorded; check.

specs.note: Pressures to expect are already recorded on the engine.

Thrust plate chamfer down, then spacer and needle bearing oiled; bearing housing bolted to the front housing; needle bearing, then balance weight with thrust washer
